notes.title: New Game Demo Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42414643/02e8c0aec3a0acad6d4327044a4727fb8a971cc5.png[/img]
[h2]Attention all Goblin's Expedition demo players! [/h2]
We've just released an update featuring a[b] brand new tutorial [/b]in the first level. 
With the new tutorial, you'll be able to learn the game mechanics quickly and easily, giving you the confidence to take on the challenges that lie ahead. So if you're ready to join Trax on his exciting expedition and face off against Azog, head to our demo page now and download the update. 
Get ready to dive into a world of adventure and puzzle-solving with Goblin's Expedition!
